packageRules.description: @scure/base is pinned to 2.2.0 in package.json's pnpm.overrides — 2.3.0 broke bech32 decoding app-wide with no compile-time signal. See CONTRIBUTING.md.

Group the Gno client stack together — these version in lockstep and a mixed-version bump is the kind of change CONTRIBUTING.md's ADR-019 note (upgrade one thing at a time, with a reason) wants reviewed as one PR, not three.
Group the monorepo's own lint/format/build tooling separately from runtime dependencies, so a tooling bump never blocks on a runtime-dependency review and vice versa.
Major-version bumps land as their own PR, never grouped — CONTRIBUTING.md's ADR-019 note applies most to majors.
